revenue.source: Schneider FY2025 results release (marketscreener/se.com) for FY2024-25; stockanalysis.com income statement for FY2023

operating_income.source: Reported operating income (EBITA less purchase-accounting amortization). FY2024 = EBITA 6,855 - 406 (FY2025 release). FY2023 ~5.93bn (Yahoo Finance 'Operating income as reported', rounded) and FY2025 ~6.69bn (Wikipedia, rounded) - rounded, reviewer should verify vs filings

d_and_a.source: stockanalysis.com cash flow statement (D&A incl. PPE depreciation + intangibles amortization; FY2023/24 match SE accounts 743+717, 822+716)

capex.source: Gross purchases of PPE + intangibles: FY2023 914+451, FY2024 950+469 (SE FY2024 accounts); FY2025 1,072 (stockanalysis) + 471 (stockanalysis)

revenue_growth.source: Assumption: FY2025 organic growth +8.9% (reported +5.2%); company target 7-10% organic; fade toward 6% as base grows and data-center cycle matures

ebit_margin.source: Assumption: FY2025 reported EBIT margin ~16.7% (6,690/40,152), adj. EBITA margin 17.8%; modest expansion consistent with company +50-80bps annual adj. EBITA target, held conservative

tax_rate.source: Assumption: FY2025 effective rate ~25% (income tax 1,455 / pretax 5,806, stockanalysis)

wacc.source: Assumption: Rf ~3%, ERP ~5%, beta ~0.9-1.0, modest leverage; ~7.5% typical for large-cap EU industrials

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: long-run nominal growth, ~eurozone inflation plus modest real growth; below WACC

net_debt.source: Schneider FY2025 results release: net debt at Dec 31, 2025 EUR 13,721m (company definition; stockanalysis shows 15,275 incl. leases)

diluted_shares.source: stockanalysis.com income statement, diluted shares FY2025 571m (rounded; Yahoo shows differing figure - verify vs filing)
